content: Letter 25, to Amīr Yūsuf Khwāja (ca. 829/1426?, Yazd or Herat?): Ibn Turka complains that despite being, by custom since the time of Ghāzān Khān, the most established man of letters in Fars, and despite his frequent and difficult trips to the royal court, he is being harassed by dīvān officials (muzāyaqa, tashvīsh), and asks the amir to intervene in this intolerable situation (TMN/MS p. 19, TMN/D pp. 187-88).
